read.en: Sandisk fell 6% on Oct 12 to $1,487, down 13% in five sessions, and closed below the Sep 16 low of $1,504. It is under its 5-day ($1,606), 10 and 30-day ($1,671–1,674) and 100-day ($1,649) averages, though still above the rising 200-day ($1,188). MACD is below its signal and zero line with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6, and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 闪迪 10月12日下跌 6%，收于 $1,487，五个交易日下跌 13%，收盘跌破 9月16日低点 $1,504。股价位于 5 日（$1,606）、10 日与 30 日（$1,671–1,674）及 100 日均线（$1,649）下方，但仍高于上行的 200 日均线（$1,188）。MACD 位于信号线及零轴下方且柱体扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月6日起看空，RSI 为 39。

read.en: The day's low of $1,464 tested the $1,473 floor that has held five times since June. A close below it would target $1,417 (Aug 24 low), then $1,325 (Jul 17 low). Resistance is $1,504, then the 5-day average near $1,606 and $1,649–1,674 (10, 30 and 100-day averages).
read.zh: 当日低点 $1,464 测试了自 6月以来五次守住的 $1,473 底部。若收盘跌破，目标看 $1,417（8月24日低点），再看 $1,325（7月17日低点）。阻力为 $1,504，其次约 $1,606 的 5 日均线，以及 $1,649–1,674（10 日、30 日和 100 日均线）。

s.en: Held five times since June; Oct 12 low $1,464
